notes.title: Level Cut Patch
notes.content:
One last update to Winging It!

[list]
[*] Fix Steam Deck resolution-related bugs.
[*] Remove some of the game's levels to shorten the overall length.
[*] Fix bugs related to removing levels, and rebalance any related numbers.
[*] Small cinematic animation edits.
[*] Level lighting adjustments.
[/list]
Looking back at Winging It, there were a lot of levels that honestly felt like "filler", and the game seems to lend itself to a shorter experience. It's been cut down to 16 levels now. The old version can still be played if you switch to the "old_uncut_version" branch (Game Properties -> Betas -> select branch). Save files will be reset.

If you try it out, let me know what you think!

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could squeeze through the ground and fall into the void.
[*] Fixed the skill tree letting you skip a tier of abilities without buying one.
[*] Fixed a case where the current level could get reset in the save file unintentionally.
[/list]
